name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-figma
description: Local MCP server for Figma: 141 tools that read and edit designs through the desktop plugin or REST

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Figma personal access token (figd_…) or OAuth token (figu_…). Needed only for the REST channel: version history, comments, other teams' libraries, files not open in the desktop app. The live-editor channel works without it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_DATA_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Data root: snapshot database, installed editor extension, captures. Default: ~/.s3l-mcp-figma.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_SANITIZATION__PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: How aggressively REST responses are trimmed before reaching the model.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_BRIDGE__PREFER_PLUGIN_FOR_READS
environmentVariables.description: Read through the live editor when it is connected; false always reads the last saved state via REST.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_CACHE__ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Keep SQLite snapshots of REST reads.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes without a tool call after which the process exits on its own; 0 disables the watchdog.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Stdio when the client starts the server, which is how a client runs this package; Http when one server runs on its own for every agent on the machine (launchd keeps it running), and clients connect to its URL.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FIGMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where the shared server answers MCP (/mcp); loopback only, and outside the bridge's port range.
